statusValues.live: Real data from a registered source, passed all checks. May render.
statusValues.pipeline_ready: Script exists and pulls real data, but fixes in the spec are still open. Must not render until promoted to live.
statusValues.placeholder: Sample values. May render ONLY with the 'Sample data' badge, and never in a client demo without saying so.
statusValues.not_sourced: No approved source. Must not render.
statusValues.retired: Removed by team decision. Must not render. Code that computes it should be deleted.

rules.name: registered
rules.rule: Every value the app renders must carry a metricId that exists in `metrics` below. Unknown metricIds are rejected.

rules.name: status
rules.rule: Render only if status is 'live', or 'placeholder' with the sample badge shown. 'pipeline_ready', 'not_sourced' and 'retired' are rejected.

rules.name: unit_and_range
rules.rule: Value must be a finite number in the metric's `unit` and inside `validRange`. Out of range is rejected, not clamped.

rules.name: missing_is_missing
rules.rule: null, NaN and any value in the source's `missingSentinels` become null and render as 'No data'. Filling, guessing, defaults and substitute metrics are prohibited.

rules.name: geography
rules.rule: The record's geography level and boundary vintage must match the metric's `geography`. Tract data on 2010 boundaries must be crosswalked to 2020 before it can be joined to 2020 shapes.

rules.name: no_unregistered_derivations
rules.rule: No value may be computed from two or more metrics. Single-metric transforms (e.g. ratio of two fields from the same table) must be listed in the metric's `transform`.

rules.name: provenance_shown
rules.rule: Wherever a value is shown, its source label and vintage are shown with it (legend, panel, or tooltip).

rules.name: one_metric_per_layer
rules.rule: Each map layer encodes exactly one metricId. Tract choropleth layers are mutually exclusive.

tract_boundary.label: Census tract
tract_boundary.plainLanguage: The official outline of a census tract — the neighborhood-sized area every tract layer is drawn on.
caveats: Tracts are statistical areas, not neighborhoods; names like 'Kensington' need a separate sourced lookup.

median_household_income.label: Median household income
median_household_income.plainLanguage: The yearly income of the middle household in the tract, in dollars.
blockers: Remove clip(lower=0) and fillna(45000) in fetch_phila_tracts.py
median_household_income.encoding: Sequential color, 5 quantile classes; gray hatch = No data
caveats: Estimate with margin of error; show ±MOE in the tract panel.

unemployment_rate.label: Unemployment rate
unemployment_rate.plainLanguage: Out of people in the tract who are working or looking for work, the share who are unemployed.
unemployment_rate.transform: unemployed ÷ civilian labor force × 100. Null if labor force is 0 or either field is a sentinel.
blockers: Store as percent everywhere (sample file uses a fraction)
unemployment_rate.encoding: Sequential color, 5 quantile classes; gray hatch = No data
caveats: People not looking for work are not counted.
Small tracts can have large margins of error.

upward_mobility_p25.label: Upward mobility (kids from low-income families)
upward_mobility_p25.plainLanguage: For kids who grew up in this tract with low-income parents, where they ranked in household income as adults (0–100).
upward_mobility_p25.transform: × 100, round to 1 decimal. Crosswalk 2010 tract IDs to 2020 tracts first.
upward_mobility_p25.encoding: Sequential color, 5 quantile classes; gray hatch = No data
caveats: Describes a past generation (born 1978–83), not current residents.

university_rd_expenditure.label: University research spending
university_rd_expenditure.plainLanguage: Total money a university spent on research in one fiscal year.
university_rd_expenditure.transform: None. Placed at the institution's main campus coordinates.
university_rd_expenditure.encoding: Tower height = sqrt(USD) × k; single blue color
caveats: Institution-wide total, not tied to a building or campus.

vc_deal_count.label: Venture capital deals
vc_deal_count.plainLanguage: Number of venture capital deals in the Philadelphia metro area in a quarter.
blockers: Deal-level locations needed before any in-city placement
vc_deal_count.encoding: Number with source and quarter; no map geometry
caveats: Private investment — never shown in the same visual form as research spending.

vc_capital_invested.label: Venture capital invested
vc_capital_invested.plainLanguage: Total venture capital dollars invested in the Philadelphia metro area in a quarter.
vc_capital_invested.encoding: Number with source and quarter; no map geometry
caveats: A single large raise can dominate a quarter.

hospital_location.label: Hospital
